```{r}
library(Maaslin2)
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
subset_pst_older_f1_YMM<-subset_samples(subset_pst_older_f1, MT == c("YMM"))
subset_pst_older_f1_YMM<-prune_taxa(taxa_sums(subset_pst_older_f1_YMM) > 0, subset_pst_older_f1_YMM)

otu_table <- as.data.frame(otu_table(subset_pst_older_f1_YMM))
otu_table<-otu_table[rowSums(otu_table) >= 1, ]

otu_table_df<-as.data.frame(otu_table)
otu_table_df<-rownames_to_column(otu_table_df,"ASV")

TT = tax_table(subset_pst_older_f1_YMM)
TT = TT[, which(apply(!apply(TT, 2, is.na), 2, any))]
tdf = data.frame(TT, OTU = taxa_names(subset_pst_older_f1_YMM))


tdf$ASV <- rownames(tdf)

pOTUtax = merge(otu_table_df, tdf, by="ASV")
pOTUtax <- pOTUtax[pOTUtax$Genus != "Chloroplast", ]
pOTUtax <- pOTUtax[pOTUtax$Class != "Cyanobacteriia", ]
pOTUtax $TAX <- apply(pOTUtax [, c("Phylum", "Class", "Order","Family","Genus")], 1, function(x) paste(na.omit(x), collapse = ";"))


# Group by Family and sum up OTU counts
library(dplyr)
pOTUtax_fam_summed <- pOTUtax %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum, na.rm = TRUE))

pOTUtax_fam_summed<-na.omit(pOTUtax_fam_summed)
pOTUtax_family_input<-column_to_rownames(pOTUtax_fam_summed,"ASV")
View(pOTUtax_family_input)
pOTUtax_family_input_filtered <- pOTUtax_family_input[rowSums(pOTUtax_family_input) >= 5, ]

# Save the summed table
write.table(pOTUtax_family_input_filtered, "OTU_table_log_summed_by_ASV.txt", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, col.names = NA)


#df_input_metadata = read.table(file = "AMCohortC_lumu_meta_v2.txt", header = TRUE, row.names = 1, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
df_input_metadata = metadata_fmt_v1
  read.table(file = "MT_MAmice_metadata_v2.txt", header = TRUE, row.names = 1, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

rownames(df_input_metadata)<- df_input_metadata$group
# Extract metadata

common_samples_maas <- intersect(rownames(df_input_metadata), colnames(pOTUtax_family_input_filtered))

# Subset OTU table to include only common samples
otu_table_filtered <- pOTUtax_family_input_filtered[, common_samples_maas]

otu_table_transposed <- t(otu_table_filtered)

# Subset metadata to include only common samples
df_input_metadata_fil <- df_input_metadata[common_samples_maas, ]

# Check the dimensions
dim(otu_table_transposed)
dim(df_input_metadata_fil)

otu_table_transposed<-data.frame(otu_table_transposed)
# Define the explanatory variables (covariates, treatments)
# For example, assuming "treatment" and "age" are explanatory variables in your metadata
```


```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Run MaAsLin2
maaslin_results <- Maaslin2(
  input_data = otu_table_transposed,  # OTU table
  input_metadata = df_input_metadata_fil,  # Metadata table
  fixed_effects = c("sex"),  # Fixed effects (e.g., treatment, age)
  output= "output_sex_YMM_F1MA-refFem_FMT",
  plot_scatter = TRUE,
  reference = c("sex,F"),
  #random_effects = c("age_type"),
  normalization = "CLR",analysis_method = "LM"
)
```

Among all the Middle-aged mice from all FMTs, there were no ASVs that were significantly different by sex.
